product.referenceContext: Original Trambustissimo instrument shaped by classic patchable analog workflows and rebuilt for standalone/AUv3 performance. PLICATA replaces hardware-oriented responsibilities where they do not make sense in software; its dedicated FOLD CV input modulates the internal wavefolder without replacing the oscillator audio path.
